articles.summary: NEW YORK, October 7, 2026 – Immunic, Inc. today announced that four abstracts highlighting new clinical, biomarker and preclinical data for its lead investigational asset, nuclear receptor-related 1 (Nurr1) activator, vidofludimus calcium (IMU-838), have been accepted for presentation at MSToronto2026
articles.title: Immunic to Present New Clinical, Biomarker and Preclinical Data on Vidofludimus Calcium at MSToronto2026 – the 10th Joint ACTRIMS-ECTRIMS Meeting
